name: Pipecat
description: Framework for real-time voice and multimodal conversational agents, with a CLI that scaffolds a runnable voice bot.
whatItDoes: Lets developers build assistants that listen, think and speak with low latency, for uses such as phone bots, meeting participants and customer service lines. A quickstart template and a separate examples repository provide working agents.
howItWorks: Audio and video frames flow through a pipeline of processors for speech recognition, language model reasoning and speech synthesis. Transports carry media over WebRTC, WebSocket or telephony, and many vendor services are swappable. A companion flows library adds structured conversation state.

requirements.name: Python and uv
requirements.description: The CLI is installed as a uv tool

requirements.name: Speech and LLM service keys
requirements.description: Credentials for the STT, LLM and TTS services chosen in the pipeline

models: Many STT, LLM and TTS providers, including speech-to-speech models
